result.summary: The interface is mostly clean and functional, but has a minor issue with text truncation on a horizontal scrolling item.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is abruptly truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement an ellipsis character or fading gradient effect for text that exceeds the container boundaries.
